capabilities: Toggle Dataview auto-refresh from the status bar
Run the toggle command from the command palette or a hotkey
Override auto-refresh per note via a dataview-refresh frontmatter property
Refresh all Dataview views immediately when auto-refresh resumes
extras: Not yet published to Community Plugins; beta installs go through BRAT (p1tt1/obsidian-dataview-toggle).
intentEvidence: lets you pause and resume Dataview's automatic refresh with one click or hotkey
motivation: The author built it because editing daily notes with Dataview task queries triggered re-renders on every keystroke, causing jank and breaking typing flow.
problem: Dataview re-renders its query blocks on every keystroke, causing jank that interrupts typing in notes with queries.

relations.evidence: Dataview plugin must be installed and enabled

summary: Status-bar toggle and command that pauses and resumes Dataview's automatic query re-rendering while you type.
